name: @sebastiangoral/claude-dash
description: A local dashboard for macOS that shows all your Claude Code sessions at once.

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node" --outfile=dist/cli.cjs && rm -rf dist/web && cp -R ../web/dist dist/web && cp ../README.md ../LICENSE .
